verdict.rationale: Google Cloud's first-party docs state that Workload Identity Federation lets on-premises or multicloud workloads reach Google Cloud resources with federated identities instead of a service account key, which is the core of the keyless story. Beyond that one direct statement, the pack offers only general IAM overview material. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of OIDC federation for CI providers (e.g. a CI pipeline setup), detail on short-lived token issuance and lifetime, end-to-end setup documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
